scope: KPF-18.1 GPU 27B Q8 with DFlash2 Q8 and no-drafter. Run A, B, C, D and same-binary fork-off. C has 16 fixed-stride lengths and DFlash2 on/off; D uses junction and near-end checkpoints at c-1/c/c+1 plus a held-out position. CPU MTP result is separate; no cross-model pooling.
historical: S1 observations on the same model and a1f0 GPU binary remain intact. This is an explicitly new replication, retaining all prior outcomes and all new attempts, not a replacement or redraw of ambiguous historical cases.
comparator: Actual exact-source e332 HIP champion versus a1f0 fork-off, same 27B target and DFlash2 argv, same prompt set and item6 groups 0,2,4,7. Binary digests and actual argv are verified; interrupted comparator is retained as unknown and never replayed.
records: Native epyc.kpf.run.v1 plus attested per-arm rows; actual returned completion probability entries, tokens and checkpoint snapshots. Per-request raw /slots samples collected while the HTTP request is active; only a sample whose processing flag and slot/task IDs match returned timing ids qualifies as active. Missing or inconsistent active samples are UNKNOWN, never zero. Post-completion slot observations are stored separately and never used as active evidence. Sampling events and errors remain durable. No full raw logits are claimed.
rule: A/B/C/D original task criteria; C evaluated over the entire fixed 16-length grid against the maximum native fresh-fresh control floor. Per-cell single-length summaries are not a grid verdict. STOP/deadline rc75 partial, own children drained.
smoke: Independent small public model with 512-token source and longer forked decode exercises actual active task-ID-matched slot observation, writer and e332 comparator through the same final wrapper. It establishes no 27B/DFlash2 target load, quality or KPF outcome.
